count_conventions: The 55 reviewed candidates split into 19 accepted, 23 excluded and 13 held. The seven pre-download exclusions and four unavailable image URLs are separate and are not counted as visually reviewed. Reddit is a source-level unavailable result with no retrievable image URL.
rules_applied: Keep new pool intake separate from previous galleries using the dated batch and immutable asset IDs.
Reject visible people and body parts, visible watermarks, prominent external source logos, promotional graphics and unrelated imagery.
Do not remove or crop source branding to make a rejected image acceptable.
Exclude GIFs, Lottie animations, videos and video posters from this photo intake.
Record holds where photographic authenticity or text-heavy presentation remains unsuitable or uncertain; do not assert a production method without evidence.
Preserve source provenance and permission evidence separately from clean public title, alt, caption and description.
Remove embedded source metadata only after recording provenance, preserving orientation and mapping source/final hashes.
Check duplicate URLs, bytes and image content within the reported scope.
Preserve native-size placement limits; do not present small assets as high-resolution hero images.
Collection, WordPress import and confirmed use are different facts; this batch performs no WordPress deployment.
authorization_record: The user supplied the source list and directed continuation of the established collection workflow. No source-specific license document was supplied or independently verified.
